# Improved Cunning Strike (`features:rogue-improved-cunning-strike`)
**Class:** [Rogue](../classes/rogue.md) | **Level:** [Rogue 11](../levels/rogue-11.md)

You can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when you deal Sneak Attack damage, paying the die cost for each effect.
